test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many languages are included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India as scheduled languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**22**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are currently **22 languages** included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Eighth Schedule lists the official languages recognized by the Indian Constitution.
 
• Initially, the Eighth Schedule included 14 languages, but subsequent amendments have added more languages to the list.
 
• Languages in the Eighth Schedule include Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu, Gujarati, Malayalam, Kannada, Odia, Punjabi, Assamese, Maithili, and others.
 
• The recognition of these languages aims to promote and preserve the linguistic diversity of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• Languages added to the Eighth Schedule are often included to recognize the cultural and linguistic significance of various regions and communities in India.
